scripts.build:electron: tsc electron/main.ts --outDir dist-electron --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('electron/preload.cjs','dist-electron/preload.cjs'); if(fs.existsSync('electron/overlay.html')) fs.copyFileSync('electron/overlay.html','dist-electron/overlay.html'); if(fs.existsSync('electron/icon.png')) fs.copyFileSync('electron/icon.png','dist-electron/icon.png'); if(fs.existsSync('electron/EyePosture.ico')) fs.copyFileSync('electron/EyePosture.ico','dist-electron/EyePosture.ico'); if(fs.existsSync('electron/EyePosture.png')) fs.copyFileSync('electron/EyePosture.png','dist-electron/EyePosture.png'); if(fs.existsSync('public/sql-wasm.wasm')) fs.copyFileSync('public/sql-wasm.wasm','dist-electron/sql-wasm.wasm');"
scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run build:electron
